# `chrome-cdp unexpose`

Take exposed functions away from pages

```text
chrome-cdp unexpose [OPTIONS] <NAME|--all>
```

Arguments:

- `<NAME>`: The functions' names

Options:

- `--all`: Take every exposed function away

```text
Examples:
  chrome-cdp unexpose onCheckout
  chrome-cdp unexpose --all
```
